title: Acid activation of proton-pump inhibitors
compartment: Secretory canaliculus of the stimulated parietal cell

steps.enzyme: Non-enzymatic protonation of the pyridine (pKa about 4)
steps.note: Charged form concentrates about 1000-fold over blood at canalicular pH about 1

steps.enzyme: Non-enzymatic protonation of the benzimidazole (pKa about 1)
steps.note: Second protonation at the luminal surface of the pump

steps.to: Disulfide-linked H+/K+-ATPase (ATP4A Cys813), arrested in E2
steps.enzyme: Non-enzymatic reaction with luminal cysteine thiols
